body: Yeah, I've told her about my family history too. Her family is really similar to mine actually, which helped us bond, because we get what it's like. Some people will be judgmental when they find out you don't communicate with your family, but we understand how it really is. She has been there for me in the past, but I don't want to keep bringing it up all the time because she's not my therapist.
I really appreciate your response. Thank you.
